context: Assess the substance of review.md against the supplied packet. Equivalent wording is acceptable. Award for grounded reasoning, not particular headings or keywords. No execution of recorded commands is needed.

checklist.name: supports_scope
checklist.description: Concludes the stated local parser verification is supported, rather than blocking solely because deployment or human approval is absent.

checklist.name: identity_checked
checklist.description: Verifies or explicitly compares the matching artifact digest and parser source digest across candidate.json, run.json and actual files.

checklist.name: relevant_revision
checklist.description: Recognizes the commit differs only in unrelated documentation and the agreed unchanged parser/artifact hashes bind this scoped verification; does not falsely report stale executable evidence.

checklist.name: coverage_and_limits
checklist.description: Credits both positive and missing-id rejection checks and preserves the handoff limits on deployment/curriculum/human acceptance.
